result:
**Round 392: PASS.** C-R391-01 is closed. All browser rows passed at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I found no new bugs, and the full test suite, build and `verify` are left to the root gate.

| Row | What happened (both viewports unless noted) |
|---|---|
| B7 (a second preview replaces the first) | The line goes from `Loading “Middle East — public preview”…` to `… is ready.` and no longer stays on the loading text. Only the Full mix preview starts. |
| B8 (preview, then Space) | Playback runs and the line ends on `is ready.`. |
| B9 (the replaced preview fails) | The line ends on `… failed to load — details are in the library.` and Full mix is the preview that plays. |
| B1, B2, B3 | Pass. A failed clip never leaves a loading text on the line. |
| B4 export with a failed clip | WAV and MP3 both download nothing and show `Export failed — no file was created. …`. |
| B5 control export | RIFF/WAVE, 48 kHz, stereo, 24-bit, 101.35 s, non-silent. |
| PERF-RES | Passes: live PCM 31.9 MiB against the 60 MiB limit, decode 0. |
| Auth (fresh context, no credentials) | `/studio-lab` opens the demo. `/studio/some-premium-product` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace, and `/api/studio-token` returns 400. Premium is not bypassed. |
| Source scope and doc 251 | The claims at the start and end of my run are identical. The only changes are the five granted files plus the new doc 251, with 0 frozen-manifest failures and 11/11 protected files intact. Doc 251 is in Georgian, has the template sections, and every test id it cites exists. |
| Neighbour check, 1440 only | A preview during playback keeps the timeline playing until the decode finishes, then the timeline stops. That stop is already tracked as out of scope. |

**For B:**
- **A-R392-REVIEW-M1:** the stale-clip "false ready" case cannot be reached in `/studio-lab` because the collection never changes. I could not reproduce it in a browser. Keep it as a signal for SRW-21 and STEM-LANES.
- **B3:** `data-playing` stays true after Space with only a failed clip. That matches round 391's accepted result, so I did not mark it a bug. A future row should say what is supposed to play.
- **Mutants:** I did not re-run A's jsdom mutants. A's `MU-392-IGNORE-ABORT` mutant survived, which A argues is equivalent, so EV25's abort branch has no red proof.
- **First-load text:** I did not observe the `Loading the demo collection…` line on first load, because my status observer is installed after it appears.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-392.md
- c-round-392.json
- c-round-392/
